types.description: Generic prefix for any AI coding agent

rules.notes: The type is one of the fixed values in `types`, joined to the description by the `separator` ("/"). `descriptionAllowedCharacters` applies to the description only and does not include the separator. Hyphens separate words in the description; dots are typically used for version numbers (e.g. release/v1.2.0). The description is lowercase with one exception: it may open with a ticket key matching `ticketKey` (e.g. feature/PROJ-123-new-login), which keeps its uppercase form. Trunk branches do not use a prefix. `grammar.regex` is the authoritative validator.

grammar.abnf:
branch-name = trunk-branch / prefixed-branch
trunk-branch = "main" / "master" / "develop"
prefixed-branch = type "/" description
type = "feature" / "feat" / "bugfix" / "fix" / "hotfix" / "release" / "chore" / "ai" / "agents" / "copilot" / "cursor" / "claude" / "codex"
description = (ticket-key / desc-segment) *("-" desc-segment)
ticket-key = UPPER *(UPPER / DIGIT) "-" 1*DIGIT
desc-segment = 1*(ALPHA / DIGIT) *("." 1*(ALPHA / DIGIT))
ALPHA = %x61-7A
UPPER = %x41-5A
DIGIT = %x30-39
